editorial:
A powerful antihero wakes up after 5,000 years and starts cleaning up his city with brutal force. The Justice Society shows up to stop him, leading to big clashes between heroes. The vibe is loud, fast, and packed with superhero action that rarely lets up from start to finish, giving you plenty of spectacle to enjoy.

Dwayne Johnson carries the movie with his tough presence, and the action scenes are huge and fun to watch. The supporting cast brings energy, especially the Justice Society members, who add heart and humor to the chaos. The pacing rarely slows down, which keeps you entertained, though the story can feel thin and some jokes fall flat. It is not deep, but it delivers exactly what you expect from a blockbuster. If you love big comic book battles, you will have a blast.
endingExplained: In the final battle, Black Adam defeats the demon Sabbac and saves his city from destruction. He then faces the Justice Society, who try to arrest him. Instead of fighting, he agrees to protect his homeland. In a mid-credits scene, Amanda Waller warns him about his actions, and Superman arrives to talk, hinting at a future showdown between the two powerful heroes on the big screen.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves big superhero action and Dwayne Johnson movies.
